Introduction



In early March 2026, Ecuadorian commandos conducted a series of raids allegedly targeting an armed group with ties to drug trafficking in the rural San Martín settlement along the country’s border with Colombia. Over six days, according to a comprehensive Human Rights Watch report, Ecuadorian troops tortured local farm workers, burned and destroyed property with no discernable connection to illicit activity, and bombed vacant land.
